mentions.name: Pawvis
mentions.description: Open-source, fully local visual hand-tracking mouse and voice control for Mac, letting users operate their computer hands-free with hand gestures and voice, with optional handoff to Codex or Claude Code for complex computer-use tasks.
mentions.problem: The creator wanted to use their computer the way it has been depicted in movies for decades.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Pawvis, visual hand-tracking mouse & voice control that's open-source and fully local on your Mac (with optional handoff to Codex or Claude Code for complex computer use tasks).
